secure_payments.title: Secure Payment Contracts
secure_payments.subtitle: Protected payments between Taskers and Taskees with built-in safeguards
secure_payments.step1List1: Taskee sends bid to Tasker with estimated start and end time
secure_payments.step1List2: The hirer accepts the bid and locks Bitcoin or Lightning in escrow. USDT coming soon
secure_payments.step1List3: Direct messages open only after escrow is formed, and only between the two of you
secure_payments.step1List4: The money stays in escrow until the hirer pays the worker's invoice
secure_payments.step1FeesText: The platform fee is deducted when a task is completed or resolved.
secure_payments.afterCreationIntro: Need to cancel a contract for some reason? Here are your options:
secure_payments.afterCreationTaskerList1: Cancel while the contract is still open and unpaid
secure_payments.afterCreationTaskerList2: Cancelling does not by itself send a refund
secure_payments.afterCreationTaskerList3: The accepted price stays as agreed
secure_payments.afterCreationTaskeeList1: Cancel an open, unpaid contract if you cannot do the work
secure_payments.afterCreationTaskeeList2: Useful if you cannot complete the task
secure_payments.step2TaskeeList1: Submit the deliverable when the work is done
secure_payments.step2TaskeeList2: The hirer approves it. Waiting does not pay you
secure_payments.step2TaskerList1: Approve the work when it matches what you asked for
secure_payments.step2TaskerList3: You pay that invoice. This usually takes a few minutes
secure_payments.step2AutoList1: Nothing is paid on a timer
secure_payments.step2AutoList2: If you do not approve the work, do not pay the invoice
secure_payments.step3StartingList1: Either person can cancel while the contract is open and unpaid
secure_payments.step3StartingList2: Talk in the bid before escrow, or in messages after escrow is formed
secure_payments.step3ResolvingList1: Do not pay the invoice if the work is not acceptable
secure_payments.step3ResolvingList2: A refund, if you agree one, is a separate payment
secure_payments.step3ResolvingList3: BitTasker cannot spend the escrow or split it for you
secure_payments.step3NoResolutionList2: Cancel while the contract is still open and unpaid
secure_payments.step3NoResolutionList3: Reviews open only after the escrow is paid
secure_payments.step4TaskerList1: Cancel while the contract is open and unpaid
secure_payments.step4TaskerList2: You cannot cancel after the invoice is paid
secure_payments.step4TaskerList3: Cancelling does not send the money back by itself
secure_payments.step4TaskerList4: Sort out the work in messages after escrow is formed
secure_payments.step4TaskeeList1: The worker can cancel an open, unpaid contract too
secure_payments.step4TaskeeList2: That cancel does not pay anyone
secure_payments.step4TaskeeList3: Use it if you cannot finish the work
secure_payments.benefitsTaskersList1: Funds held securely until work is done
secure_payments.benefitsTaskersList2: You pay only after you approve the work
secure_payments.benefitsTaskersList3: You can cancel an open, unpaid contract
secure_payments.benefitsTaskersList4: There is no automatic refund timer
secure_payments.benefitsTaskeesList2: You are paid when the hirer pays your invoice, not on a timer
secure_payments.benefitsTaskeesList3: Messages open after escrow is formed
secure_payments.benefitsEveryoneList1: Bitcoin or Lightning. USDT coming soon
secure_payments.benefitsEveryoneList3: The hirer pays the invoice after approval
secure_payments.contractStatesIntro: Depending on which steps you've taken in the contract process, your contract will have one of the following statuses:
secure_payments.state1Description: Contract created, waiting for work to start
secure_payments.state3Description: Still unpaid. Either side can cancel
secure_payments.reviewPeriodList1: Starts when the worker submits the work
secure_payments.reviewPeriodList2: The hirer approves it, or does not
secure_payments.reviewPeriodList3: Waiting does not release the payment
secure_payments.disputePeriodList1: After approval, the worker requests payment
secure_payments.disputePeriodList3: This usually takes a few minutes
secure_payments.exampleSuccessList1: Tasker creates a contract and funds it
secure_payments.exampleSuccessList2: Taskee completes the work and marks it complete
secure_payments.exampleDisputeList1: The work is submitted and the hirer does not approve it
secure_payments.exampleDisputeList2: They do not pay the invoice
secure_payments.exampleDisputeList3: Either side cancels the open contract
secure_payments.exampleDisputeList4: No money moves on a timer
secure_payments.exampleAutoList5: Reviews can be left after that payment
secure_payments.gettingStartedList1: Sign up with a passkey on this device
secure_payments.gettingStartedList2: Open your wallet with the same passkey
secure_payments.gettingStartedList3: Add Bitcoin, or buy bitcoin with a card or bank transfer
secure_payments.gettingStartedList4: Post a task or send a bid, then lock escrow
secure_payments.gettingStartedList5: Approve the work and pay the invoice
secure_payments.faq1Question: What happens if the Tasker doesn't accept my completed task?
secure_payments.faq1Answer: Nothing is paid until they approve the work and pay your invoice. Waiting does not pay you.
secure_payments.faq2Question: Can I cancel a contract after work has started?
secure_payments.faq2Answer: Yes, while the contract is still open and has not been paid. Cancelling does not send a refund by itself.
secure_payments.faq3Question: How many times can I propose a resolution during a dispute?
secure_payments.faq3Answer: There is no proposal counter. If you disagree, cancel the open contract or do not pay the invoice.
secure_payments.faq4Question: What if we can't agree on a dispute resolution?
secure_payments.faq4Answer: There is no automatic refund. BitTasker cannot split the escrow for you.
secure_payments.faq5Answer: The service fee is charged when a task is completed. Network fees for Bitcoin or Lightning are separate.
secure_payments.faq6Answer: A refund is a separate payment you both agree. It is not a button that empties escrow on a timer.
secure_payments.faq7Question: How is this different from sending payment directly?
secure_payments.faq7Answer: Escrow holds the money until you approve the work and pay the invoice. Paying someone directly does not do that.
secure_payments.faq8Question: What if I need to change something after creating the contract?
secure_payments.faq8Answer: The accepted price stays as agreed. You can cancel while the contract is open and unpaid.
secure_payments.importantNotesList1: All transactions are final once confirmed on the blockchain
secure_payments.importantNotesList2: Nothing is paid on a timer
secure_payments.importantNotesList5: Your contract is secure and transparent
secure_payments.process1Description: Tasker creates and funds the contract
secure_payments.simpleProcessConclusion: Messages open after escrow is formed. Reviews open after the invoice is paid.
